liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Peggy O** (4 reviews): Reviewer considers this the best Peggy-O they know of; Reviewer has loved this Peggy-O since hearing an old tape of the show over ten years ago [14][16][17][19]
- **Sugaree** (2 reviews): Called possibly the most powerful Sugaree the reviewer has heard, alongside the one on Dicks Picks Vol. 3; Sugaree gives the reviewer chills, among the best they have heard [17][20]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): The Scarlet into Fire transition is called great, with a long, epic solo of over two minutes; The jam going from Scarlet into Fire is described as nasty [13][17]
- **St. Stephen** (2 reviews): St. Stephen is judged weaker than other 1977 versions; The St. Stephen jam contains ideas Garcia later developed in Not Fade Away on 1-7-78 [18][22]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Tennessee Jed and Scarlet are noted for great grooves [20]
- **Supplication** (1 review): Bobby's vocal on Supplication is singled out as killer [19]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): The first set closed with a hot version of this song [12]
- **Fire on the Mountain** (1 review): Fire is called remedial [18]

## Setlist highlights

- Earliest performances in the archive: Scarlet [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-05-05.sbd.unknown.261.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 175 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd77-05-05.sbd.stephens.8832.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 180 min; rated 4.75/5 by 77 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording quality is excellent and sounds great on a variety of playback devices [20]
- **gd1977-05-05.sbd.cantor.7725.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 173 min; rated 4.85/5 by 13 [3]. Said about its sound: Notes two drops in this transfer, around the 1:02 and 6:00 marks of disc one track five [3]
- **gd1977-05-05.171014.mtx.dusborne.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 181 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [5]
- **gd1977-05-05.148735.SBD.Betty.Anon.Noel.t-flac2448**: soundboard; 19 songs; 181 min [6]

## Around the show

- The second set followed the traditional format and was even stronger than the first set [12]
- Overall a good show, but somewhat overshadowed by the stronger shows around it [13]
- Judged as good as any May 1977 show; 5-13-77 in Chicago is also recommended [14]
- Peggy-O solo is judged less emotional and less well played than the one on the 9th [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-05-05.sbd.unknown.261.shnf**: transferred by Unknown; source: Soundboard [1]
- **gd77-05-05.sbd.stephens.8832.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1977-05-05.sbd.cantor.7725.shnf**: transferred by Troy Wallwork; source: master reels > dat [3]
- **gd1977-05-05.171014.mtx.dusborne.flac1644**: source: 2 Source Matrix by dusborne [5]. Also: Soundboard work credited to Rob Eaton and Dan Stephens; audience cassettes from Doug Lamarre; Charlie Miller and Scott Clugston worked on the sources [5]
- **gd1977-05-05.148735.SBD.Betty.Anon.Noel.t-flac2448**: taped by Betty Cantor; transferred by Source & Transfer by Anonymous;Edited & Mastered using Adobe Audition by Joe Noel; source: Source: Betty Cantor's SBD Reel Master > PCM > Beta PCM clone > cloned to wav file on computer by Sony SLHF300 Betamax and modified Sony PCM601esd via spdif… [6]. Also: Betty soundboard source shared anonymously; an unknown audience recording was transferred by Pete Ebel [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - 1977-05-05 Veterans Memorial Coliseum, New Haven, CT](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2018/07/grateful-dead-1977-05-05-veterans.html) [24]
- Fan art by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - 1977-05-05 Veterans Memorial Coliseum, New Haven, CT](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2018/07/grateful-dead-1977-05-05-veterans.html) [25]

- Poster by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Veterans Memorial Coliseum, New Haven CT 1977 - RSD BF 2024 - 180 Gram Vinyl - EX UK Vinyl box set](https://us.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-veterans-memorial-coliseum-new-haven-ct-1977-rsd-bf-2024-180-gram-vinyl-ex-uk-vinyl-box-set-603497824694-878352) [27]
